purpose: Stage A feasibility pilot. On one pinned real C++ target, verify the end-to-end path from copy-only automatic AST instrumentation through sanitizer build and deterministic SGFuzz replay. This is a mechanism and buildability check, not a randomized fuzzing-performance experiment.

conditions.description: A clean copied IXWebSocket source tree, built and replayed without instrumentation.
The same copied source tree, with automatic AST instrumentation limited to IXWebSocketTransport.cpp.

interpretation_rule: Pass requires both sanitizer builds and deterministic replays to exit successfully, the upstream source checksum to remain unchanged, and each observed callback/STT tuple to equal its pre-recorded value. STT states include the root; leaves are distinct root-to-leaf transition sequences. The results do not measure executions per second, code coverage, bug discovery, or randomized-fuzzing effectiveness.
